scientific.integrity: The source DEMON schedule and SGDM recurrence are used exactly. The true varying-product momentum tail is summed by a finite backward recurrence, and the source geometric proxy is compared algebraically without asymptotic replacement.
limitations: Structural identity for the DEMON momentum schedule rather than a loss-function convergence theorem.
Integer finite horizon and initial momentum strictly between zero and one.
The tail refers to a fixed momentum component; a newly injected gradient uses the one-step-shifted tail.
No optimality or uniqueness claim for the DEMON schedule.

title: DEMON exactly linearizes its true finite-horizon momentum tail
